pick.headline: Moscow replaces Kazakhstan's Kunayev, setting off riots in Alma-Ata
pick.summary: On December 16, 1986, Moscow replaced Kazakhstan's party leader Dinmukhamed Kunayev with Gennadiy Kolbin, a Russian; Kazakh students protested in Alma-Ata the next day and the protests were put down by force.
pick.significance: It was the first major outbreak of national unrest of the Gorbachev era.

alternates.headline: Kazakhstan declares independence
alternates.summary: On December 16, 1991, Kazakhstan declared independence, the last Soviet republic to do so.
alternates.significance: Kazakhstan held a large share of the Soviet nuclear arsenal.
